name: Miniature toggle switch (6 mm bushing)
summary: The little metal flick switch with a threaded collar and a nut. Needs a 6.2 mm round hole.
source: The threaded bushing on miniature toggle switches of the MTS-102 family is M6 x 0.75, so it is 6 mm across and a 6.2 mm hole lets it drop in without forcing. That bushing size is consistent across the whole commodity family, which is why the hole is trustworthy. The rest is not: body size, how far the terminals reach behind the panel and the lever length differ between the two-position and three-position versions and between suppliers. Some of these also have a small anti-rotation tab beside the bushing, which needs its own notch in the panel or must be snapped off.

keepouts.label: Room for the washer and fixing nut
Room to flick the lever from side to side
Room for the solder tags and wires behind the panel

electrical.note: Commonly rated 6 A at 125 V AC or 3 A at 250 V AC. Most hobby uses switch low-voltage DC far below that.
